website.note: Homepage describes Revita and Rejuva at high level; no dedicated /pipeline page returned content (404). Investor portal ir.fractyl.com timed out.

ctgov.note: Sponsor lookup with 'Fractyl' and 'Fractyl Health' returned 0 trials in the cached compact file. REMAIN-1 NCT was identified via web search (NCT06484114) and added manually.

indications.indication: Maintenance of weight loss after GLP-1 based therapy discontinuation in obesity
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled pivotal study; randomization completed February 2026; co-primary endpoints: weight regain at 6 months and responder rate at 1 year
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed July 2025; randomization completed February 2026; topline 6-month data expected early Q4 2026)
key_milestones: One-year REMAIN-1 Midpoint Cohort randomized data Q3 2026
Topline six-month REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort data early Q4 2026
Potential FDA De Novo marketing application submission late Q4 2026 (post-GLP-1 weight maintenance)

commercial_product.name: Revita
commercial_product.status: Limited pilot commercial launch in Germany since Q1 2023; investment paused under Strategic Reprioritization (Jan 2025); no 2025 revenue recognized.

excluded_preclinical: RJVA-001 (Rejuva pancreatic AAV gene therapy for T2D) — CTAs submitted in EU (Netherlands) and Australia in H2 2025; first-in-human dosing not yet initiated as of 10-K filing date; classified as IND/CTA-pending, not yet in active P1.
RJVA-002 (dual GIP/GLP-1 gene therapy) — preclinical development.
excluded_legacy_terminated: REVITALIZE-1 (Revita for Type 2 Diabetes) — investment paused under Strategic Reprioritization announced January 31, 2025 (not driven by safety/efficacy concerns; existing participants followed per protocol).
Germany Real-World Registry study (Revita for T2D) — investment paused under Strategic Reprioritization.
